Class PhoneNumberExtensions

Namespace
PhoneNumbers.Extensions
Assembly
PhoneNumbers.Extensions.dll

C#-idiomatic extension methods over PhoneNumber for the formatting and validity checks callers reach for most often, so they read as number.ToE164() / number.IsValid() instead of PhoneNumberUtil.GetInstance().Format(number, PhoneNumberFormat.E164).
